targets.name: neon-jaytibirthday-db
targets.notes: Postgres warehouse for analytics and telemetry (D-9). MOVED 2026-10-27 (D-35): the data now lives in project jolly-cake-01200063 ('neon-cyan-fountain') of organization org-billowing-meadow-62228264, branch br-royal-wave-b8y8k9vw ('main'), endpoint ep-dark-dew-b8hbowlx, DATABASE jpbir_live - the database name is part of the target and was preserved. The move was a migration, not an organization transfer: both organizations are Vercel-managed (managed_by=vercel) and Neon cannot transfer projects into or out of such an organization. jpbir_live was dumped and restored with exact count verification (29 tables, 132,496 rows on both sides) and the four connection secrets now name this project. The previous warehouse - project fancy-cloud-99501540, branch br-spring-pine-au5jtfig, endpoint ep-long-credit-au7qr9gy, database jpbir_live - is LEFT INTACT as the rollback copy, together with its stale 'neondb' database (a copy frozen at 2026-10-09T18:30Z); deleting it is a separate decision with its own approval. Local credentials live OUTSIDE the repository (a .env.local inside the tree is read by the test suite).

targets.name: jp-agent-render
targets.notes: The jp-agent runtime behind jaytipargal.tech, verified live 2026-10-19. Vercel reaches it through JP_AGENT_URL (Backend/agent-run.js). Deployed from git; render.yaml declares the service shape, and no deploy script, ssh path, systemd unit or nginx config exists in this repository. DNS: runner.jaytipargal.tech and jp-agent.onrender.com both resolve to gcp-us-west1-1.origin.onrender.com via Cloudflare, TLS CN=runner.jaytipargal.tech valid to 2027-01-17. GET /health -> 200 {ok:true,service:"jp-agent",mcp:"in-process"}; /sessions -> 401 without a bearer token. "mcp":"in-process" means the standalone s24-mcp server is not in use and the tools are served in-process from s24-tools.mjs.
